title: Jotham’s Reign

questions.question: How old was Jotham when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:1 (ESV): "Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: What did Jotham NOT do that his father Uzziah did?
options: He did not invade the temple of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: He did not invade the temple of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:2 (ESV): "...only he did not invade the temple of the LORD."

questions.question: What did the people continue to do?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:2 (ESV): "...But the people still followed corrupt practices."

questions.question: Which gate of the house of the LORD did he build?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:3 (ESV): "He built the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD..."

questions.question: Who did Jotham fight against and prevail?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:5 (ESV): "He fought also with the king of the Ammonites and prevailed against them."

questions.question: Why did Jotham become mighty?
options: Because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God
questions.correctAnswer: Because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:6 (ESV): "So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God."

questions.question: How much silver did the Ammonites give him?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:5 (ESV): "...And the Ammonites gave him that year 100 talents of silver..."

questions.question: How much wheat did they give him?
For how many years did the Ammonites pay tribute?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:5 (ESV): "...The Ammonites paid him the same amount in the second and the third years."

questions.question: How long did Jotham reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:1 (ESV): "...and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who reigned in Jotham's place?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:9 (ESV): "...And Ahaz his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: Where else did Jotham do much building?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:3 (ESV): "...and on the wall of Ophel he built much."

questions.question: What did he build in the hill country of Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:4 (ESV): "And he built cities in the hill country of Judah..."

questions.question: What did he build in the forests?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:4 (ESV): "...and forstresses and towers in the forests."

questions.question: Where was Jotham buried?
options: In the tombs of the kings
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 27:9 (ESV): "Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David..."

key_verse_text: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.
